Renee (Finance): Recon alerted 62 Stripe payments marked succeeded but no NetSuite invoices. Spotted at 09:24 UTC. Can payments/infra please triage?

Omar (Payments): Checking Stripe delivery logs now. Any recent changes to billing-sync?

deploy-bot: ALERT: webhook failures for /webhooks/netsuite 09:18:02 - 09:30:10 UTC. Failed events=62. Error: 51 x SignatureVerificationError, 11 x UpstreamHTTP(500). See /ops/webhooks/alerts/1742523456

Diego (Backend): We rotated NETSUITE_WEBHOOK_SECRET in the 09:00 deploy and shortened timestamp tolerance to 120s for extra security. Logs show many rejects: "SignatureVerificationError: timestamp outside tolerance" 09:19-09:22.

Keiko (Ops): I rotated the secret but missed updating Stripe's endpoint signing secret via the UI/API. Rolling previous secret back into env now and restarting pods.

Diego (Backend): I'll push a quick fallback: verifier will try current + previous signing secrets for 48h. Also changing create retry logic: treat NetSuite 409 externalId as idempotent -> call GET instead of retry create. Hotfix coming.

deploy-bot: DEPLOY: billing-sync v2.18.0-hotfix by Diego at 09:28 UTC. Canary passed.

Omar (Payments): Sample event evt_4PqRS showing metadata.external_ref=INV-2026-03-27-314. I queued 20 events for manual backfill and dedupe on stripe_event_id.

Keiko (Ops): Opened NS ticket NS-10021 for partial create cleanup and asked NetSuite to unlock conflicting external_ids before backfill.

Renee (Finance): Please export CSV for CS: stripe_event, external_ref, customer_email, amount_usd, currency, stripe_status. Need it in 30m.

Diego (Backend): CSV saved to /finance/recon/ops/1742523456-missing_invoices.csv. Backfill queued but holding until NetSuite confirms cleanup.

Omar (Payments): Backfill plan: 1) dedupe stripe_event id, 2) attempt create -> on 409 GET existing, 3) on 5xx flag for manual review. Will post progress.

deploy-bot: BACKFILL-JOB queued (job_id=rb-1742523456-1).

Keiko (Ops): NetSuite acknowledged NS-10021: will clear 8 partial records within 2 hours and provide guidance on safe re-run.

Omar (Payments): Backfill started at 09:52 UTC after NetSuite ack. Progress: processed=62 created=54 fetched_existing=0 blocked=8. No duplicate charges found. CSV attached above.

Renee (Finance): Good. Please include a postmortem: root cause = secret rotation + tight timestamp window + retry-as-retryable on 409; impact = 62 events delayed, 54 reconciled, 8 pending; remediation = dual-secret fallback, change 409 handling, add rotation checklist + automated sync to Stripe.

Diego (Backend): Will draft postmortem and open PRs for automated Stripe secret sync and alerting on signature failure spikes. Also adding unit test that simulates in-flight events during secret rotation.

Keiko (Ops): Added alert: webhook.signature.failures > 10 within 5m -> escalate to #eng-oncall and #finance. Also updated runbook to include pre-rotation Stripe secret update and retaining previous secret for 48h.

Renee (Finance): Thanks team. CS notified. Please post when the 8 pending are cleared and when the postmortem is ready. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: RESOLVED: webhook spike ended 10:00 UTC. Monitoring until 10:30 UTC.
